main.name: Pratiksha Shrestha
main.description: My passion lies in working on data-focused, large-scale projects, and I also enjoy exploring machine learning and blockchain technologies. I am currently seeking dynamic Software Engineer roles where I can leverage my diverse skill set and continue to grow professionally.
bio: As a seasoned Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience,  I specialize in creating scalable data management, logistics, and e-commerce solutions.I graduated with a degree in MS in Computer Science from Miami University in 2024. I currently work as a Software Engineer at CTDI. My core strengths are in backend development and data integration using ASP.NET Core, Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). I am continually learning and currently enhancing my frontend development skills while exploring blockchain technology.
main.contactmessage: You can contact me at pratiksha.shrestha97@gmail.com.

bio: My primary research interest is in applying blockchain technology to solve real-world problems. Under the guidance of Dr. Bhunia at Miami University, I designed a blockchain-based anonymous tokenization solution to incentivize academic peer reviewers.

publications.title: P Shrestha, S Bhunia, A Carvalho, C Anderson, G. Lee, “A Case Study on Blockchain-based Anonymous Reviewer Incentive Token (BARIT)”, in IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (IEEE SMC) 2024.
